Given $△ABC$ shown above, which of the following diagrams represents the height corresponding to $\overset{―}{AB}?$
feedback.worked_solution:
The height (or altitude) corresponding to $\overset{―}{AB}$ is a line segment that 

- runs from the opposite vertex $C$ to the line $\overset{⟷}{AB},$ and

- is perpendicular to $\overset{⟷}{AB}.$

To draw the height, we proceed as follows:

- Extend the line segment $\overset{―}{AB}.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13945712/assets/ff359409206e3762233b6db6159b00b69d95124e8c1bd21597c36a9fde535f3f.png)

- Draw the perpendicular from $C$ to $\overset{⟷}{AB}.$
